Amortization of debt issuance costs was $ 16 million in 2018, $ 16 million in 2017, and $ 14 million in 2016. Amortization of our debt premium, net, was $ 65 million in 2018, $ 81 million in 2017, and $ 88 million in 2016. Debt repayments: in july and august 2018, we repaid $ 2.7 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes that matured in the period. We funded these long-term debt repayments primarily with proceeds from the new notes issued in june 2018.
